mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia can potentiate QT prolongation risk associated with escitalopram, particularly at higher doses; loop diuretics may also increase escitalopram levels through volume depletion.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly; consider ECG monitoring if escitalopram dose exceeds 20 mg daily; ensure adequate potassium supplementation if needed.
